rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof shingles is textbook property damage to the home structure.
claim_summary: Policyholder reports wind damage to four roof shingles on back porch overhang; no water intrusion into the house. Estimated repair cost $400. Deductible is $2,500.

case_facts.description: Wind blew approximately four shingles off overhang above back porch
